theme_strategy.light_theme_rule: The light theme MUST remain predominantly white with crisp contrast, clean margins, and warm gold accents.

brand_design_tokens.font_stack: Barlow, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

scrim_overlay_guidance.dark_mode_scrim: bg-gradient-to-t from-[#07090f] via-[#07090f]/75 to-transparent or bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-[2px]
scrim_overlay_guidance.light_mode_scrim: bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/50 to-transparent for white/gold text over photos
scrim_overlay_guidance.wcag_requirement: Ensure text over photography maintains at least 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratio by employing directional gradient scrims and dark text shadow (`drop-shadow-md`). Never display un-scrimmed light text over light photo areas.

hero_slideshow_specifications.ken_burns_effect: scale-105 to scale-100 slow smooth zoom, disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is active
hero_slideshow_specifications.reduced_motion_fallback: Instant or simple 200ms opacity crossfade without scale transformation

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files (do not use .tsx files).
Add explicit data-testid attributes to ALL buttons, links, form inputs, sliders, and navigation items (e.g., data-testid='hero-slide-next-button', data-testid='language-toggle-es').
Hero slider must auto-advance every 6 seconds with smooth crossfade and subtle Ken Burns zoom, and support manual pause/play controls.
Text overlaid on hero images or page banners MUST use a gradient scrim (e.g. from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent) so text is 100% readable (4.5:1 ratio) in both light and dark themes.
Maintain dark theme (#07090f) by default with gold (#c9a84c) accents and cream (#f4f0ea) text; in light theme, keep background predominantly crisp white (#ffffff).
Include EN/ES language switcher in navigation header.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling continuous pan/zoom animations in the hero slider.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize audience-focused warmth with real human photography across all page headers.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use asymmetric bento grids and layered depth.
Include micro-animations on interactive elements (hover lift, gold border glow).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
